chapterInfo.content:
139
Onyankopɔn yɛ honhom
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ. Dawid dwom.
1 # Dwom 139.23; 7.9 AWURADE, wohwehwɛ me mu, na wohu me.
2 # Yer 17.10 Wo na wonim m’asetena ne me sɔreɛ,
wohunu m’adwene mu akyirikyiri.
3Wohwehwɛ me nanteɛ ne me nna mu,
na wonim m’akwan nyinaa mu yie.
4Na asɛm biara nni me tɛkyerɛma so
gye deɛ wo, AWURADE, wonim ne nyinaa no.
5Woaka me ahyɛm, m’akyiri ne m’anim,
na wode wo nsa ato me so.
6Saa nimdeɛ yi yɛ me nwanwa dodo,
ɛkɔ soro dodo, mentumi nnuru koraa.
7Ɛhe na mɛfiri wo honhom no anim madwane makorɔ?
Na ɛhe na mɛfiri w’anim madwane makorɔ?
8 # Amos 9.2 Sɛ meforo soro a, wowɔ hɔ,
na mpo mekɔsɛ me kɛtɛ Asamando a, woni!
9 # Yona 1.3 Sɛ mefa adekyeeɛ ntaban metu
mekɔtena ɛpo akyiri nohoa a,
10ɛhɔ nso na wo nsa bɛkɔ akɔgya me,
na wo nifa bɛsɔ me mu.
11 # Hiob 34.22 Na sɛ mese: Esum nko mmɛkata me so
na me ho hann nnane anadwo a,
12 # Yak 1.17 esum nso nnuru sum mma wo,
na anadwo hran sɛ awia,
esum ne hann yɛ wo pɛ.
13Na wo na wobɔɔ me sawa,
wonwonoo me, me na yam.
14Meda wo ase sɛ woyɛɛ me maa no yɛɛ hu ne nwanwa,
wo nneyɛɛ yɛ nwanwa,
na me kra nim saa yie.
15 # Skf 11.5 Me nnompe anhunta wo,
berɛ a wɔyɛɛ me ahuntaeɛ mu
na wɔnwonoo me asase mu tɔnn no.
16 # Hiob 14.5 Meyɛ mogya toa nko no,
w’ani hunuu me,
na wo nwoma mu, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa,
nna a wɔahyɛ asie
na emu baako pɛ nnya mmaeɛ no.
17 # Yes 55.9 Na me deɛ, Onyankopɔn,
sɛdeɛ w’adwene boɔ si yɛ me den!
Sɛdeɛ ɛsi dɔɔso!
18 # Dwom 40.5; 63.6 Sɛ merekan a, ɛdɔɔso sene anwea,
menyane a, meda so mewɔ wo ho ara.
19Onyankopɔn, sɛ wobɛkum abɔnefoɔ
na mogyapɛfoɔ afiri me so akɔ ɛ!
20Wɔn a wɔkasa tia wo mmusuo mu
ne w’atamfo a wɔbɔ wo din ahuhudeɛ mu no.
21AWURADE, wɔn a wɔtane woɔ no, mentane wɔn anaa?
Na wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ no, me werɛ nho wɔn anaa?
22Mede ɔtane pa metane wɔn,
mebu wɔn m’atamfoɔ.
23 # Dwom 139.1 Onyankopɔn, hwehwɛ me mu, na hunu m’akoma,
sɔ me hwɛ, na hunu m’adwene,
24 # Dwom 27.11 na hwɛ sɛ amaneɛ kwan bi wɔ me hɔ,
na gya me kɔ daa kwan so!

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE, wohwehwɛ me mu, na wohu me.
Wo na wonim m’asetena ne me sɔreɛ,
wohunu m’adwene mu akyirikyiri.
Wohwehwɛ me nanteɛ ne me nna mu,
na wonim m’akwan nyinaa mu yie.
Na asɛm biara nni me tɛkyerɛma so
gye deɛ wo, AWURADE, wonim ne nyinaa no.
Woaka me ahyɛm, m’akyiri ne m’anim,
na wode wo nsa ato me so.
Saa nimdeɛ yi yɛ me nwanwa dodo,
ɛkɔ soro dodo, mentumi nnuru koraa.
Ɛhe na mɛfiri wo honhom no anim madwane makorɔ?
Na ɛhe na mɛfiri w’anim madwane makorɔ?
Sɛ meforo soro a, wowɔ hɔ,
na mpo mekɔsɛ me kɛtɛ Asamando a, woni!
Sɛ mefa adekyeeɛ ntaban metu
mekɔtena ɛpo akyiri nohoa a,
ɛhɔ nso na wo nsa bɛkɔ akɔgya me,
na wo nifa bɛsɔ me mu.
Na sɛ mese: Esum nko mmɛkata me so
na me ho hann nnane anadwo a,
esum nso nnuru sum mma wo,
na anadwo hran sɛ awia,
esum ne hann yɛ wo pɛ.
Na wo na wobɔɔ me sawa,
wonwonoo me, me na yam.
Meda wo ase sɛ woyɛɛ me maa no yɛɛ hu ne nwanwa,
wo nneyɛɛ yɛ nwanwa,
na me kra nim saa yie.
Me nnompe anhunta wo,
berɛ a wɔyɛɛ me ahuntaeɛ mu
na wɔnwonoo me asase mu tɔnn no.
Meyɛ mogya toa nko no,
w’ani hunuu me,
na wo nwoma mu, wɔatwerɛ ne nyinaa,
nna a wɔahyɛ asie
na emu baako pɛ nnya mmaeɛ no.
Na me deɛ, Onyankopɔn,
sɛdeɛ w’adwene boɔ si yɛ me den!
Sɛdeɛ ɛsi dɔɔso!
Sɛ merekan a, ɛdɔɔso sene anwea,
menyane a, meda so mewɔ wo ho ara.
Onyankopɔn, sɛ wobɛkum abɔnefoɔ
na mogyapɛfoɔ afiri me so akɔ ɛ!
Wɔn a wɔkasa tia wo mmusuo mu
ne w’atamfo a wɔbɔ wo din ahuhudeɛ mu no.
AWURADE, wɔn a wɔtane woɔ no, mentane wɔn anaa?
Na wɔn a wɔsɔre tia woɔ no, me werɛ nho wɔn anaa?
Mede ɔtane pa metane wɔn,
mebu wɔn m’atamfoɔ.
Onyankopɔn, hwehwɛ me mu, na hunu m’akoma,
sɔ me hwɛ, na hunu m’adwene,
na hwɛ sɛ amaneɛ kwan bi wɔ me hɔ,
na gya me kɔ daa kwan so!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
